title: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1995

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1995
ACT VIII OF 1995
SINDH EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment)
Act, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th October, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/95, dated
25-10-1995.--The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Bill,
1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 10th September,
1995 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th October 1995 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Employees Special Allowance Payment Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Amendment in Sindh Act X of 1986

ACT VIII OF 1995
ACT VIII OF 1995
SINDH EMPLOYEES SPECIAL ALLOWANCE (PAYMENT) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An Act further to amend the Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment)
Act, 1986
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 25th October, 1995]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/95, dated
25-10-1995.--The Sindh Employees Special Allowance (Payment) (Amendment) Bill,
1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 10th September,
1995 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th October 1995 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment in Sindh Act X of 1986.--In the Sindh Employees
Special Allowance (Payment) Act, 1986, after section 13-A, the following shall
be added:--
"3-B. In
addition to the allowances admissible, under sections 3 and 3-A every employee,
irrespective of wages being paid to him, shall, in respect of his employment on
or after the 1st day of May. 1995, be paid by his employer an
additional special allowance equal to one hundred rupees per month."
